call_points.text: 18th consecutive interim dividend of ₹14.40 a share, the highest ever quarterly dividend.
About $700 million cash, $600 million net of debt; no U.S. treasury exposure.
No buyback policy or target multiple; management said if a buyback had not been announced, it is waiting.
Won a 3-year letter of award on one rig; two rigs now need repricing this year.
One rig idle since end-April; management hopes to contract it after the monsoon.
Samudra Manthan offshore programme: too soon for capex plans, no new tenders seen on the ground.
All ships that had to leave the Strait of Hormuz have come out; one remains on charter to ADNOC within the Strait.
Strait of Hormuz disruptions caused trade pattern shifts and long-haul trades, driving a big spike in freight rates.
Group debt stands at $157 million as of March 31, and is expected to be paid out within the next two years.
Around 80% of vessel days for the current financial year have already been locked in.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Greatship (India) Limited (‘GIL’), a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, has received the 8 Notices of Review . Joint Commissioner of State Tax issued review notices for financial years 2013-14, 2014-15, 2016-17 and April 2017- June 2017 u/s 25 of the MVAT Act, 2002 r/w CST Act, 1956. The review is proposed of the appeal / rectification orders passed by the Deputy Commissioner of Sales Tax (Appeals), Mumbai regarding treatment of the charter hire of vessels / rigs under MVAT Act, 2002, exemptions granted under CST Act and taxing the charter-hire revenue at correct rates.Vide the said Notices, the Joint Commissioner has requested GIL to submit its objections, if any, against such an order of review.

Fleet of 40 ships with an average age of 14.5 years, plus 19 offshore vessels and 4 rigs; about 25-26% of capacity is on time charter.
Crude tanker order book at 27%, VLGC at 35%, product tankers 20-21% and bulk carriers about 14%.
Q2FY27 cover: crude tankers at a TC of $90,000 a day and product tankers at $45,000 a day, with about 90% cover for supply vessels.
Contracted to buy a secondhand Very Large Gas Carrier of about 82,000 cbm built in 2015, expected to join the fleet in Q3 FY27.

timeline.summary: In April 2026, GE Shipping took delivery of the Kamsarmax dry bulk carrier Jag Abhishek, expanding its fleet to 41 vessels.
Shareholders approved Mrs. Bhavna Doshi’s re-appointment as Independent Director via Postal Ballot on April 30, 2026, with 90.37% voting in favor.
In May 2026, GE Shipping delivered the MR tanker Jag Prakash, bringing its owned fleet to 40 vessels.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,511.4 Cr (+23.6% YoY), net profit ₹1,044.09 Cr (+187.6% YoY).
GE Shipping reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,857 Cr and net profit of ₹1,044 Cr, with an interim dividend of ₹11.70 per share.
In May 2026, Great Eastern Shipping reported record Q4 and full-year FY26 results with a consolidated net profit of ₹1,044 Cr and announced a highest-ever quarterly dividend of ₹11.70 per share.
GE Shipping contracted to buy a secondhand Very Large Gas Carrier of about 82,000 cbm for delivery in Q3 FY27.
